# v1.3.3 — Performance & stability hardening

## What changed

### Server hot paths

- **Bounded caches.** The in-memory caches that backed chapter and API lookups
  now have hard size caps, so long-running sessions can no longer grow them
  without limit.
- **SQLite tuned for reads.** Added the missing indexes plus sensible pragmas
  and a prepared-statement cache, cutting repeated query overhead on the
  hot paths.
- **`/api/health` under control.** Health checks now run with bounded
  concurrency so a burst of probes can't stampede the process.
- **Crash safety.** Express error middleware catches async route failures, and
  an `uncaughtException` handler logs and exits with `process.exit(1)` instead
  of leaving the server in a broken state. Request bodies are capped at 6mb.
- **Cheaper logging.** Log writes are batched instead of flushing on every
  line.

### Downloads

- **The queue is now O(N) instead of O(N²).** Enqueue/dequeue no longer rescan
  the whole queue on every operation.
- **Real cancellation.** Cancelling a download actually stops its in-flight
  work rather than letting it finish in the background.
- **500-chapter clamp.** A single batch is clamped to 500 chapters so one
  request can't pin the queue.

### Client runtime

- **Reader scrolling is smooth.** Scroll handling is coalesced through
  `requestAnimationFrame` and layout measurements are cached.
- **No more listener leaks.** Event listeners are properly torn down when
  views are replaced.
- **API traffic deduped and bounded.** Identical in-flight requests are
  deduped, the client cache has a size cap, and retries are capped.
- **Lazy modules.** `tts.js` loads on demand.

### Startup weight & offline

- **Lighter boot.** The render-blocking Tesseract CDN script is gone, `marked`
  is deferred, and an unused OpenCV inpaint worker was dropped.
- **Safer service worker.** The dynamic cache is bounded and an offline shell
  fallback serves when the network is unavailable.

### OTA durability

- **Staging dirs are pruned and installs are serialized**, so an interrupted or
  concurrent update can't leave partial state behind.

## Notes

- No user-facing feature changes; this release is about keeping the app fast and
  stable under load and over long sessions.
- Adds 8 regression test files guarding the caches, queue limits, logger
  batching, OTA cleanup and service-worker behaviour.
